map.📖 评估（伦理/责任/持续教育）: 📖 Appraiser Ethics, Responsibility and Continuing Education
map.房地产评估师职业道德自检工具，从独立性、客观公正、专业胜任、保密义务、持续教育5: A self-check tool for real estate appraiser ethics, covering independence, objectivity, professional competence, confidentiality and continuing education.
map.📖 查看「评估（伦理/责任/持续教育） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Appraiser Ethics, Responsibility and Continuing Education User Guide"
map.评估师职业道德评分 = 独立性 + 客观公正 + 专业胜任 + 保密义务 + 持: Appraiser ethics score = independence + objectivity + professional competence + confidentiality + continuing education + conflict avoidance + report standards + fee compliance (0 to 3 points each, 24 in total); 21 or above is excellent, 16-20 good, 10-15 needs improvement, and below 10 fails with immediate remediation required.
map.1. 独立性：评估是否受委托方不当影响: 1. Independence: is the appraisal improperly influenced by the client
map.2. 客观公正：评估依据是否充分客观: 2. Objectivity: is the evidence sufficient and impartial
map.3. 专业胜任：是否具备相应资质和能力: 3. Professional competence: are qualifications and capability adequate
map.4. 保密义务：是否妥善保护客户信息: 4. Confidentiality: is client information properly protected
map.5. 持续教育：是否完成年度继续教育: 5. Continuing education: has annual CPE been completed
map.6. 利益冲突回避：是否回避利害关系: 6. Conflict avoidance: has any interest been recused
map.7. 报告规范：评估报告是否符合规范: 7. Report standards: does the report comply with the standards
map.8. 收费合规：收费是否符合标准: 8. Fee compliance: do fees meet the standard
map.评估师应保持独立性，不受委托方不当影响: Appraisers must stay independent and free of improper client influence
map.与评估对象有利害关系的应当回避: Anyone with an interest in the subject property must recuse
map.年度继续教育不少于60学时，其中面授不少于30学时: Annual continuing education is at least 60 hours, of which at least 30 are in person
map.违反职业道德可能面临行业自律处分或吊销资质: Breaching professional ethics can bring industry disciplinary action or revocation of qualification
map.评估机构年度合规自查按八项打分。: Firms score the eight items in their annual compliance self-review.
map.持续教育学时是否达标核对。: Check whether continuing education hours meet the requirement.
map.独立性、客观公正、专业胜任、保密、持续教育、利益冲突回避、报告规范、收费合规各: Independence, objectivity, professional competence, confidentiality, continuing education, conflict avoidance, report standards and fee compliance each score 0-3, for 24 in total; 3 on every item gives an excellent 24.
map.一个周期 3 年，年度不少于 60 学时、面授不少于 30 学时、专业伦理不少于: A cycle runs 3 years with at least 60 hours a year, at least 30 in person and at least 6 on professional ethics; falling short counts as a fail.
map.职业道德不合格后果？: What follows from failing the ethics check?
map.轻则限期整改，重则行业自律处分、记入信用档案，影响执业资格与出具报告效力。: At the lighter end, remediation within a deadline; at the heavier end, industry disciplinary action and a credit record entry, affecting the licence and the validity of issued reports.
map.利益冲突怎么回避？: How should conflicts of interest be handled?
map.与委托方存在亲属、投资或债权债务关系时应主动声明并回避，不得参与该项目评估。: Where a family, investment or debtor-creditor relationship with the client exists, declare it and recuse; you may not take part in that appraisal.
